title: Group Bike Ride & Drinks
description: Join us for a friendly monthly group ride. Casual rides, all levels of bicyclists are welcome. Rides vary in length and difficulty — some are a slow, easy tour of town with kiddos in tow, where we stop to share our dreams and vision for bike-friendly roads in Beacon, others are longer, faster rides across the river to Newburgh or beyond. Check our Instagram, where we post route plans the week before.

description: Incorporating a mix of storytelling and various musical genres, Mr Corbitt delivers a diverse sensory experience to entertain your little ones! title: Lit Lit Writers Open Mic
description: Please get there by 6:30 PM if you want to sign up to read. Lit Lit is a monthly literary open mic series in Beacon, NY. We (usually) meet the first Friday of every month at the Howland Cultural Center. To help the Howland meet its costs, they ask for a donation of $5 per person (no one will be turned away for lack of funds). Lit Lit is all about welcoming writers from every walk of life and every genre, to share their own writing of up to 5 minutes in length. We love you and we want to hear what you’ve been working on. Or just come and listen. Wine, beer, soft drinks and snacks will be available by donation.

title: Mutual Aid Beacon Food Distribution for Seniors
description: Mutual Aid Beacon runs a drive thru free food distribution on the 1st and 3rd Wednesdays of every month at Memorial Park in Beacon. First Wednesday is for seniors age 60+ (or with a senior in the household), third Wednesday is open to all. Enter the park near Ron’s Ice Cream.

title: Story Screen Movie Trivia
description: You read correct, babies!! Our good pals over at Draught Industries are letting us take over the bar for yet another night of record-spinning, chin-scratching and general fun-having!
